high_level_description: A luminous human brain suspended in a tall glass specimen jar with a brass stopper, painted as a moody near-monochrome sepia watercolor plate on dark parchment, wide and cinematic; one centered hero object, generous empty negative space to the right.

style_description.aesthetics: moody and reverent; dramatic watercolor with strong chiaroscuro, a deeply dark field with a single faint glow lifting the subject, strictly near-monochrome sepia with minimal warmth, a little eerie
style_description.lighting: a single soft pale glow from within the glass jar is the main light; the surroundings sit in deep soft shadow, readable but clearly dark, the far edges fading to near-black parchment with a gentle vignette
style_description.medium: watercolor on grained dark parchment, delicate linework, soft transparent washes, near-monochrome sepia, desaturated, visible paper grain
style_description.art_style: an antique scientific plate from a Victorian field volume, dramatic, wide and cinematic, the subject catalogued as a specimen

compositional_deconstruction.background: A dark grained aged-parchment ground, soft vignette to near-black at the edges; the field is deliberately sparse — a faint suggestion of a wooden shelf line behind the object, dimly lit but legible, in the same near-monochrome sepia palette.

elements.desc: a tall glass specimen jar with a brass stopper, centered in the LEFT two-thirds of the frame and slightly left of dead-center, containing a luminous human brain that glows softly from within; the glass catches one pale highlight along its rim; fine watercolor linework for the glass, soft washes for the brain's hemispheres; the right third of the frame stays open dark parchment
